title: Remove derived DeepGram key fallback
description: Update timestamp enrichment code and tests so DeepGram is loaded only from explicit payloads or attachment keys.

comments.author: ec2-user
comments.text: Investigation found timestamp enrichment still derives a DeepGram attachment key from item metadata when no explicit attachment is present. Updating specs first so enrichment only uses embedded payloads or recorded attachment keys.

comments.author: ec2-user
comments.text: Implemented scoring-side behavior: LangGraph timestamp enrichment no longer derives a DeepGram object key from item metadata when no explicit payload or attachment key is present. Verification: focused LangGraph attachment/no-attachment specs passed; Tactus runtime-control tests passed. Full LangGraphScore_test.py still has unrelated local environment failures requiring Azure credentials and async fixture cleanup.
